entities.summary: The Deutsche Reichspartei (DRP) was a nationalist, far-right, and later neo-Nazi political party in West Germany. It was founded in 1950 from the German Right Party, which had been set up in Lower Saxony in 1946 and had five members in the first Bundestag, and from which it took the name. In the second Bundestag election (1953), the DRP got 1.1 % of the votes. A certain success and only major breakthrough came in the 1959 Rhineland-Palatinate regional election, when it got 5.1 % of the votes and sent a deputy to the Landtag of Rhineland-Palatinate.
